events.title: 孙权征黄祖
吕蒙击破黄祖前锋
凌统、董袭攻城并屠城
黄祖亡走
黄祖被冯则追杀并枭首
孙权派贺齐讨黟、歙
分歙置始新、新定、犁阳、休阳四县并设新都郡
刘表去世
鲁肃请求出使吊唁刘表诸子并观察局势
曹操抵达刘表境内
刘琮率众向曹操投降
刘备与鲁肃相见并接受孙权旨意
刘备进驻夏口
诸葛亮出使孙权
孙权遣周瑜、程普等出军
赤壁之战
曹操焚余船引退
刘备、周瑜等追击至南郡
曹操北还并留军守江陵、襄阳
甘宁在夷陵被曹仁部党围困
吕蒙提出救援甘宁之计
凌统留守拒曹仁，孙权分兵救甘宁并获胜
孙权围攻合肥
张昭攻九江当涂而不利
孙权攻合肥逾月不下而退
曹操遣张喜率骑兵赴合肥
曹军未至合肥孙权退兵

warnings.message: Source explicitly states that Feng Ze pursued Huang Zu and beheaded him, but the allowed predicates contain no faithful predicate for beheading or causing a specific death; the event is preserved without a forced claim.

Source explicitly states that Huang Zu's men captured tens of thousands of men and women, but the allowed predicates contain no faithful predicate for capture of persons; the assertion is preserved in the source text without a forced claim.

Source explicitly states that Lu Su requested authorization to mourn Liu Biao's sons and observe the changing situation, but no allowed predicate faithfully represents requesting authorization or an observational mission.

Source explicitly states that advisers urged Sun Quan to receive Cao Cao and that Zhou Yu and Lu Su advocated resistance, but the allowed predicates do not faithfully represent advice, advocacy, or strategic opposition in these assertions.

Several source mentions are context-dependent abbreviations or titles, including 权, 祖, 肃, 公, 琮, 备, 瑜, 普, 仁, 宁, 昭 and 曹公; they are preserved as mentions and linked document-locally without canonical resolution.
Events are dated to 建安十三年 / 208 with spring or inherited year context; no verified Gregorian month or day conversion is supplied, so normalized precision remains year_only.
